_metadata.description: Provider-neutral request contracts for AI Gateway callers.

requirements.title: Text inference requests use role, profile, and constraints instead of concrete models
requirements.description: AI Gateway must expose a stable request shape for chat, generation, summarization, classification, and structured extraction. Callers provide task intent, role, optional profile, and constraints; they do not provide Ollama/OpenRouter model slugs.

validation.notes: Validates provider-neutral text request parsing, defaults, and role/profile fields.
Validates rejection of concrete provider/model/embedding metadata fields.

requirements.title: Embedding requests carry role and schema metadata requirements
requirements.description: Embedding requests must be role-based and must return enough metadata for callers to persist model identity, dimensions, content hash/version, and retarget compatibility information.

validation.notes: Validates that callers cannot smuggle implicit embedding dimensions through provider-specific metadata; full embedding metadata response support remains in progress.
